## Changes

### New
- Linux: an in-app WebView. "Open in WebView" shows the site inside the app, and sources that need a browser (e.g. behind Cloudflare) load. It needs WebKitGTK 4.1, which most desktops already have (`libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0` on Debian and Ubuntu, `webkit2gtk4.1` on Fedora); without it pages open in the browser as before.
